game.q: a big donor’s name goes on the wall. someone slips in five dollars they needed. where does the mongoose roll?
opts: straight to the name on the wall
in the five dollars someone needed

wrong.wall: the wall is shiny. the mongoose doesn’t care.
wrong.nap: fair. but it never stops looking.

game.right: YES. not the size of the gift. what it cost the giver.

end.line: a king gave mountains of gold. a poor family gave their last meal. only one turned the mongoose gold.
end.l1: a king gave mountains of gold.
end.l2: a poor family gave their last meal.

cliff.s2: he asks his closest friends for one thing. they fall asleep.

share: a mongoose. half gold. fully unimpressed. the mahabharata on infinite hill
